title: Hinomori Shiho — Sound & Calligraphy〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Okay, I got here earlier than usual today, so I think I'll practice a bit on my own...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Hm...?
There's something on top of that desk... Someone's fortune?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
A “great blessing” too.
But it looks handwritten...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You saw it!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You saw it, didn't you?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Uh, Rin, MEIKO?
What's going on here? What did I see...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hold on. You mean this?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Correct!
Of all the people who could've found it, you ended up being the one.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I knew it was a bad idea to leave it here... Even if we did just leave to deal with our pens running dry.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hang on... Are you two saying that you're making your fortunes?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Yes, that's right.
Rin came up with the idea of making a type of Omikuji that only gives out “great blessings” just for Honami.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah!
She didn't get one at the shrine this year, right?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That's why I want her to start off the new year with a great, big smile by drawing a “great blessing”.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Isn't it a wonderful idea?
And so, I decided to help out.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I see... Now it makes sense.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Also, now that you know our plan, you're one of us...♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait, what...?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh.
There's no escape, Shiho♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Y-You too, MEIKO?!
A few hours later

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Phew... That went pretty well.
I feel like that's enough for today in terms of a full group practice.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Whew... We practiced a ton today...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You have work after this, right, Honami...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, I do.
I was actually just about to head out.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'll probably stick around a while longer to practice some stuff on my own. There's a part that still needs more work.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, I'll stay too!
There are some parts that I wanna practice with you, Ichi.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
If that's the case...
I'll stick around for a bit too.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Sorry, everyone. I wish I could stay to practice, but I really do need to go. Maybe next time...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Anyway, I'll see you tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Bye!
Stay safe!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Shall we get started right away?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Before that... Can I have a minute with you guys?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hm? Sure, Shiho. What's up?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I kinda want your help making “great blessings” for Honami...

rows.Speaker: Ichika & Saki
rows.Line: “Great blessings”...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, so Rin and MEIKO are making it for her! That's so thoughtful of them!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
An Omikuji with only “great blessings”...
Hehe. Honami's going to love that.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What do you need help with exactly?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: The idea is to write all these “great blessing” fortunes, but we're still not sure what to write for each section.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Each section?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Regarding education, others who you're awaiting and stuff, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I was hoping that you could help us come up with things that Honami would like.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, totally!
Let's come up with a whole bunch of them!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I'm in too.
By the way, have you written something, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Y-Yes... Uh...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, can we see?!
Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
“Education: You'll be fine. (If anything, I'd like you to tutor me in math.)
Music: You're developing your very own sound while staying in perfect rhythm. Keep it up.”

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Haha. Only you would write this, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But this would totally send any of us over the moon, you know?! I'm gonna write one too♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
What should I say?
“Ambition: I want some of your apple pies, Hona!” How's that?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Isn't that what you want?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh no! I-Is that Hona?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wh-What do we do?! She'll find out...!
